item.title: Version 1.7.0
item.description:
BreakMate v1.7.0

# BreakMate 1.7.0 — Customizable Companions, Productivity Insights & PiP Improvements BreakMate 1.7.0 brings a more personal desktop companion, clearer productivity insights, and a smoother break experience. ## What's New - **Build a 3D companion:** Customize your companion's shape, species, breed, colors, and expression, then give it a name of your own. - **Track your workday:** Explore activity segments and inspect how your time is distributed across focused work. - **Clock out with a reflection:** Wrap up the day with a guided end-of-day reflection. - **Let your companion wander:** Enable companion movement around the workspace and adjust its behavior. - **See your habits:** Companion settings now include a summary of break and focus streaks. - **More ways to take a break:** Try animated poster reminders, automatic posture and eye-rest prompts, a yearly break statistics heatmap, and the Night Sky break template. ## Improvements - Improved Picture-in-Picture dragging, sizing, positioning, and background controls. - Refined companion rendering, gaze tracking, and interactions. - Improved macOS single-instance startup and application focus handling. - Improved cleanup for secondary overlay windows. Build 36 · 17 October 2026

Installation Note (macOS)

Since BreakMate is not notarized by Apple, macOS may show a security warning on first launch. Open System Settings > Privacy and Security and click Allow Anyway next to BreakMate.

item.title: Version 1.6.0
item.description:
BreakMate v1.6.0

# BreakMate 1.6.0 **New:** - **App Usage Analytics** — Local, privacy-first tracking of active foreground apps, giving you clear visibility into where your desktop time goes. View it on the Statistics screen and in Settings → Privacy. - **Category Daily Budgets** — Set daily time goals for specific application categories (e.g. Browsing, Social, Entertainment) and track your limits throughout the day. - **Focus Score & Trend Charts** — Measure your daily focus score, track multi-day focus trends, and celebrate sustained focus streaks as you build healthier working habits. - **Weekly Digest & Export** — Receive an automated weekly breakdown of your productivity habits, break compliance, and top apps with one-click export support. - **6 New Curated Themes** — Expand your visual experience with Crimson Ember, Ocean Abyss, Aurora Borealis, Desert Dusk, Lavender Mist, and Monokai Pro (12 curated themes in total). - **Template Accent Customization** — Personalize and pin custom accent colors directly to individual break overlay templates in Settings → Break Appearance. - **Revamped Wellness Library** — Browse and filter wellness exercises by category with interactive preview cards and updated daily goals. - **Smarter Meeting Detection** — Improved native detection and video conference URL recognition to seamlessly defer scheduled breaks during active meetings. **Improved:** - Updated core dependencies for enhanced performance, smoother animations, and platform stability. - Native app icon caching on macOS and Windows for fast, crisp icon rendering. **Under the hood:** - Added Windows app tracking native bridge support. - Strengthened automated test coverage for analytics, timer orchestration, and privacy features.

item.title: Version 1.5.0
item.description:
BreakMate v1.5.0

# BreakMate 1.5.0 **New:** - **Global Hotkey** — press ⌘⌥B (Ctrl+Alt+B on Windows) anywhere to start a break instantly, or skip the one you're in. Toggle it in Settings → General. - **Presentation Pause** — BreakMate now notices when you're in a fullscreen presentation or video call and holds off on breaks until you're done. Toggle it in Settings → Smart Detection. (macOS only for now — Windows support is on the way.) - **Companion Streaks** — your desktop companion now celebrates real milestones (3, 7, 14, 30, 60, 100 days) as you build a consistent break habit. Check your progress in Settings → Companion. - **Smarter Meeting-Aware Scheduling** — when a break would land during a meeting, BreakMate now looks ahead across your calendar to find the next real gap, instead of just waiting 5 minutes and trying again. **Improved:** - Smaller install size — break-screen slideshow images were re-optimized (~13 MB → ~2.3 MB) with no visible quality loss. **Under the hood:** - Internal settings-code cleanup and documentation fixes — no visible changes, just a healthier codebase going forward.

item.title: Version 1.4.0
item.description:
BreakMate v1.4.0

# BreakMate Release Notes — v1.4.0 (Build 33) **Date:** June 16, 2026 **Release Title:** Desktop Companion Engine & Environment Builder ## Summary This major update introduces a completely overhauled Desktop Companion experience. We've built a custom sprite animation engine, a flexible environment builder, and an interactive Picture-in-Picture (PiP) overlay to ensure your companion stays with you across all your workspaces. --- ## 🚀 What's New ### 🐾 Desktop Companion Engine A new animation and behavior system that makes your desktop pets feel more alive. - **Sprite Rendering Engine:** Optimized for low CPU usage while supporting complex animations. - **Advanced State Machines:** Pets now have more fluid transitions between idling, moving, and resting. - **Ground-Padding Detection:** Dynamic stabilization ensures pets stay perfectly aligned with their environment. ### 🌎 Environment Builder Customize your companion's world exactly how you like it. - **Live Preview:** See changes in real-time as you build your environment. - **Theme Configuration:** New repository-backed themes for consistent world-building. - **Interactive Decorations:** Added background birds and environment-aware props. ### 🖼️ Interactive PiP Overlay Keep your companion visible without it getting in the way. - **Cross-Workspace Visibility:** High-performance overlay window that floats above other apps. - **Smart Initialization:** Updated persistence for PiP settings. --- ## 🛠️ Improvements & Refinements ### 📦 Centralized Storage System - Migrated to a unified `StorageService`. - Built-in data migration logic for seamless updates. - Multi-process access management for improved stability. ### ⚙️ Infrastructure & Architecture - **Service Bootstrapping:** Modernized startup sequence for faster app launches. - **Dependency Injection:** Refined DI configuration using a modular pattern. - **NPC Unification:** Consolidated movement and component logic for better performance. --- ## 🐞 Bug Fixes - **Painting Errors:** Fixed occasional zero-size rendering issues on window resize. - **High-DPI Support:** Improved crispness and scaling on 4K Windows displays. - **UI Cleanup:** Removed intrusive scrollbars from settings and dashboard pages. --- ## 📊 Build Details - **Version:** 1.4.0 - **Build Number:** 33 - **Commit Range:** v1.3.0...HEAD

item.title: Version 1.2.1
item.description:
BreakMate v1.2.1 — Native macOS Calendar & Permission Recovery

In this update, I have focused on making the calendar integration robust and reliable for macOS users. I've replaced the generic calendar plugin with a high-performance native implementation and significantly improved the user experience around permission management.

  • Native macOS Calendar Support: Custom native bridge using Apple's EventKit framework for flawless performance.
  • Advanced Permission Handling: Added clear recovery paths and direct system settings access when permissions are denied.
  • Enhanced Dashboard Visualization: Grouped upcoming events by date for better schedule visibility.
  • macOS Sonoma Compatibility: Added specific support for macOS 14+ privacy requirements and security entitlements.
  • Stability Fixes: Resolved startup crashes and improved meeting detection precision.

item.title: Version 1.1.4
item.description:
BreakMate v1.1.4

## BreakMate v1.1.4 — Onboarding Persistence & Storage Stability This update addresses a long-standing issue where user onboarding data was not persisting correctly across application restarts. I've overhauled the storage architecture to ensure a more reliable experience on macOS. ### 🛠️ Core Fixes & Enhancements - **Onboarding Persistence Fix:** - Resolved the "Onboarding Loop" where users were repeatedly prompted to complete onboarding after each app restart. - Implemented a **Dual-Sync** mechanism: Critical flags (onboarding, interval, strict mode) are now mirrored to a separate, high-stability Key-Value store. If the main settings snapshot is ever stale or fails to load, the app automatically recovers state from this mirror. - **Storage Architecture Overhaul (macOS):** - **Path Relocation:** Moved the internal database from `~/Documents/breakmate_db` to `~/Library/Application Support/breakmate_db`. This aligns with macOS best practices and prevents data loss from manual user file management. - **Automatic Migration:** Added logic to detect legacy databases in the Documents folder and seamlessly move them to the new Application Support location on the first run of v1.1.4. - **Lock File Self-Healing:** Implemented automatic cleanup of stale `lock.mdb` files. This prevents the app from failing to start if a previous instance crashed or didn't release the database lock properly. - **Resilient Data Loading:** - Added robust `try-catch` blocks to the `SettingsRepository` load sequence. - Enhanced JSON decoding for complex fields (Exercises, Activity Patterns) to handle nulls or malformed strings without crashing the entire settings load. - Added explicit debug logging across the storage lifecycle for better traceability. - **Developer Experience:** - Fixed a compilation error regarding `unawaited` futures by properly importing `dart:async`. - Incremented build version to `29` for Sparkle update compatibility. ### 📄 Documentation Updates - Updated `README.md` with a new **Storage & Persistence Architecture** section. - Added project credits: "Built with Flutter by Bijith P N". ### 📦 Version Information - **Version:** 1.1.4 - **Build:** 29 - **Release Date:** May 31, 2026 ### Installation Note (macOS) Since BreakMate is not notarized by Apple, macOS may show a security warning on first launch. 1. Double-click the `BreakMate-Installer.dmg` and drag BreakMate to your Applications folder. 2. Right-click (or Control-click) the BreakMate app and select Open. 3. If it still blocks, go to **System Settings > Privacy & Security** and click **Allow Anyway** next to BreakMate.

item.title: Version 1.1.3
item.description:
# BreakMate v1.1.3 — Stability, Dev Isolation & Version Alignment
This update introduces critical fixes to resolve a startup crash and optimizes the developer experience by isolating telemetry in development environments.
### What's Changed
* **Startup Crash Fix:** Resolved a critical runtime exception (`Tried to use Provider with a subtype of Listenable/Stream`) by shifting the injection of `StatsService` inside `MultiProvider` to `ChangeNotifierProvider.value`. Subscribed widgets can now dynamically listen to background metrics calculations safely. * **Sentry Dev Mode Isolation:** Bypassed Sentry telemetry initialization in debug/profile builds using the `kReleaseMode` check. This completely silences verbose connection warnings and native SDK exceptions when developing locally. * **Sparkle Version Alignment:** Aligned all build metadata to version `1.1.3+28` to ensure that macOS users receive updates correctly without redundant update dialog prompts.
### Installation Note (macOS)
Since BreakMate is not notarized by Apple, macOS may show a security warning on first launch.
1. Double-click the BreakMate-Installer.dmg and drag BreakMate to your Applications folder. 2. Right-click (or Control-click) the BreakMate app and select Open. 3. If it still blocks, go to **System Settings > Privacy & Security** and click **Allow Anyway** next to BreakMate.

item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
BreakMate v1.1.0 — Performance Refactoring & Pet Fatigue

This update brings major performance improvements under the hood, upgrades to how state is synced across components, and the introduction of the new Pet Fatigue AI behavioral model.

AI Pet Fatigue (Phase 3.1)

  • Your companion pet now dynamically shows tired behavior as your day goes on. The behavioral decision engine tracks your cumulative work hours throughout the day.
  • If you have worked for 3 hours or more, the pet is much more likely to sleep or rest, while high-energy animations like running or jumping are naturally discouraged so the pet stays calm.

Isolate Exception Fix & Better Stability

  • Resolved the services library crash that was occurring in background isolate communication.
  • Implemented a proxy method channel pattern so that background polling operations for idle status and smart app detection run reliably on separate Dart threads without causing UI micro-stutters or engine crashes.

Isolate State Synchronization

  • Synced target end times and daily work totals across the main app and overlay components, making sure the companion desktop panel is always aligned with the main app status.

Core Code Refactoring (Phase 2.1)

  • Simplified the large monolithic TimerEngine class by breaking it down into smaller, focused modules: TimerStateData (state properties), TimerRepository (persistence), and TimerContextManager (focus mode and meeting detection).

Performance Optimization

  • Added aggressive memory cleanup by clearing pet theme image caches when switching pet selections.
  • Wrapped fast-ticking timer elements in RepaintBoundary widgets to avoid redrawing the entire companion overlay window unnecessarily.

Installation Note (macOS)

Since BreakMate is built independently and is not verified by Apple, macOS will show a security warning when you attempt to launch it for the first time.

  1. Double-click the BreakMate-Installer.dmg file and drag BreakMate to your Applications folder.
  2. Open your Applications folder, right-click (or Control-click) the BreakMate app, and select Open.
  3. If it still blocks launch, go to System Settings > Privacy & Security, scroll down to the Security section, and click Allow Anyway next to the BreakMate notice to authorize it.
